description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Working Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking experienced Software Developers to contribute to a cutting-edge AI research initiative focused on improving the capabilities of advanced AI models in software development.
 In this role, you will evaluate AI-assisted software development sessions and coding workflows used to train and assess frontier AI models. You will review end-to-end coding trajectories generated through AI-powered developer tools, assessing code correctness, problem-solving approaches, workflow efficiency, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
 You will provide structured, rubric-based feedback to help improve how AI models understand development requirements, generate code, debug issues, and execute complex, multi-step programming tasks.
 This opportunity is ideal for software engineers with strong coding and debugging expertise who are familiar with modern AI-assisted development tools and agentic or specification-driven workflows.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Evaluate end-to-end software development sessions produced using AI-assisted coding tools.
 Assess code quality, correctness, functionality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
 Review multi-step coding trajectories to determine whether the AI follows a logical and effective development workflow.
 Identify bugs, implementation gaps, inefficient approaches, and errors in AI-generated code.
 Evaluate the quality of reasoning, debugging strategies, and problem-solving demonstrated throughout development sessions.
 Review full-stack and backend development tasks across different programming environments and system architectures.
 Provide clear, structured, and actionable written feedback based on predefined evaluation rubrics.
 Identify opportunities to improve AI-generated code, development workflows, and agentic coding capabilities.
 Required Qualifications & Skills
 Minimum 3+ years of professional software development experience .
 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
 Practical understanding of agentic coding, AI-powered development environments, and specification-driven workflows.
 Strong code-reading, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities.
 Experience working with full-stack or backend software systems.
 Ability to evaluate complex, multi-step coding workflows and assess their correctness, efficiency, and overall quality.
 Strong understanding of software development principles, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
 Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and provide detailed evaluation feedback.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working with Kiro or Amazon CodeCatalyst.
 Previous experience evaluating, reviewing, or grading AI-generated code.
 Contributions to developer tools, engineering productivity platforms, or open-source software projects.
 Familiarity with AI agents and automated software development workflows.
 Contract & Payment Terms
 Engagement will be on an independent contractor basis.
 The role is fully remote and offers flexible working hours, allowing you to complete assignments on your own schedule.
 Project duration may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on business requirements and individual performance.
 Payments will be processed weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 The role will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Candidates requiring H-1B or STEM OPT sponsorship are not eligible for this opportunity at present.
 Equal Opportunity
 All qualified applicants will be considered without discrimination based on legally protected characteristics under applicable laws. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application process upon request.
